question: Does the seed2001 task0 drop in homogeneous joint4 relative to the current-code single-task baseline reproduce on an independent training seed when per-task updates, sample slots, and LR exposure are matched?

falsifiable_hypotheses.name: single_task0_pipeline_replication
falsifiable_hypotheses.claim: The task0-only 40k recipe reaches at least 11/20 paired successes and 5/5 fixed-init3 on a new training seed.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: Either registered task0 threshold is missed.

falsifiable_hypotheses.name: joint4_task0_retention_replication
falsifiable_hypotheses.claim: At matched per-task task0 update/sample/LR-factor exposure, homogeneous joint4 remains below the task0 11/20 paired threshold while the task0-only control passes.
falsifiable_hypotheses.falsifier: Joint4 passes the unchanged task0 gate, or the single-task control fails so the comparison cannot isolate a multi-task-associated change.

current_evidence_basis.historical_vs_fresh_single_task0: 13/20 versus 14/20 paired; both 5/5 fixed-init3; exact paired McNemar p=1.0; same previously used 20 initializations.
current_evidence_basis.seed2001_single_vs_joint4_task0: 14/20 versus 10/20 paired; both 5/5 fixed-init3; 3 gains, 7 losses, 10 ties; exact paired McNemar p=0.34375.
current_evidence_basis.registered_four_task_gate: Joint4 task0 missed its 11/20 threshold; Fold02 and eight-task scaling remain locked.
current_evidence_basis.exposure_design: Registered task0-only 40k and joint4 160k give task0 40k optimizer updates and 80k sample slots; joint task0 LR-factor positions map to the 40k single-task schedule at floor(global_update/4). Shared optimizer state and parameter trajectories differ by design.
current_evidence_basis.existing_cpu_training_loss_audit: Logged loss falls substantially in both conditions; reconstructed final-100 task0 loss medians are 0.104 single versus 0.099 joint, with last logged values 0.097 versus 0.088. Joint task alignment is reconstructed from the pinned sampler because the log has no task-id field; similar loss is not an environment-success measure.
current_evidence_basis.existing_cpu_failure_phenotypes: All four profiled task0 single-success/joint-failure pairs end at the 300-step cap with terminal reward 0; paired single successes take 78-134 steps. In a separately registered trace summary, near-zero action collapse was falsified: joint final-window action medians were 0.55-0.77 of paired single controls, with sustained nonzero motion. These n=4 summaries do not distinguish optimization insufficiency from multi-task effects.
current_evidence_basis.interpretation_limit: One additional matched training seed improves replication evidence but does not establish a population-level or causal multi-task interference effect.

options_compared.option: Launch eight-task training or unlock Fold02 now
options_compared.reason: The existing four-task progression gate failed on task0; the objective requires the gate before expansion.

options_compared.option: Repeat the exact seed2001 pair or its evaluation
options_compared.reason: That finite chain is complete; an identical replay adds cost without a new falsifiable contrast.

options_compared.option: Run only another task1 single-task model
options_compared.reason: It would address the task1 diagnostic but not the current four-task gate's primary task0 failure.

options_compared.option: Run a new seed2002 task0-only 40k plus homogeneous joint4 160k pair, then evaluate task0 on the single model and all four tasks on joint4
options_compared.reason: This is the most direct bounded replication of the failed four-task retention gate and the single-task positive control while preserving matched per-task exposure.

pre_registered_outcome_interpretation.single_task0_positive_control_fails: If either task0-only threshold is missed, the matched joint comparison cannot establish retention loss against a passing single-task control; keep expansion locked and investigate single-task seed/recipe stability.
pre_registered_outcome_interpretation.single_task0_passes_joint4_task0_fails: A new-seed replication of the task0 retention miss supports a multi-task-associated difference under this recipe, but remains a two-seed descriptive result and is not causal proof; keep expansion locked.
pre_registered_outcome_interpretation.task0_passes_but_any_joint_task1_to_3_fa: The four-task gate fails unchanged; report the exact failing task and do not expand.
pre_registered_outcome_interpretation.single_task0_and_all_joint4_task_gates_p: The registered four-task gate passes for this pair, but this proposal does not authorize Fold02 or eight-task training; require a separate gate review and explicit authorization.

authorization_and_progression.preflight_required: Rebuild candidate configs only after authorization; then verify source/config/code/data/model/runtime hashes, dataset parity, exclusive GPU lock, disk, and every unique path before any one-shot launch.

gate_required_to_progress.tasks1_to_3: at least 10/20 paired and 5/5 fixed-init3 each
